meta.note: The compact theme sets no colours of its own; the colour values below are a reference rendering of the ANSI names the theme emits. The user's terminal palette decides the real colour.

tokens.name: term-bg
tokens.usage: The terminal background. Every specimen sits on it; ops never paints a background itself.

tokens.name: term-surface
tokens.usage: Window chrome around specimens in docs (title bar). Not emitted by ops.

tokens.name: term-border
tokens.usage: Hairline frame of a specimen window. Decorative only (below 3:1); never carries meaning.

tokens.name: term-fg
tokens.usage: Default foreground. Compact leaves header, label, separator, duration and summary uncoloured, so nearly everything renders in this.

tokens.name: term-dim
tokens.usage: ANSI `dim`: the running row's `{elapsed}` and an Info report result. 5.3:1 on term-bg in both themes.

tokens.name: ansi-cyan
tokens.usage: ANSI `cyan`: the braille spinner on a running row (`{spinner:.cyan}`). The theme's only motion colour.

tokens.name: ansi-green
tokens.usage: ANSI `green`: an Ok report result (`color_ok`). Step ✓ icons stay term-fg.

tokens.name: ansi-red
tokens.usage: ANSI `red`: an Error report result (`color_error`). Failure on a step line is told by ✗ and the error block, not colour.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "DejaVu Sans Mono", monospace

styles.name: cell
styles.usage: The reference cell: every rendered line. ops measures in columns, so one size serves all output.

styles.name: cell-bold
styles.usage: ANSI `bold`: the report title (`title_color`). The only weight change compact makes.

styles.name: cell-dense
styles.usage: Specimens in narrow docs columns. Same grid, smaller cell.

styles.name: cell-small
styles.usage: Config keys and captions beside specimens.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Doc and cover titles only. Never in CLI output.

spacing.note: ops lays out in terminal columns. Cell tokens are in em at the 0.6em advance of a monospace face (1 cell = 1ch).

tokens.name: cell-1
tokens.usage: One column: `left_pad = 1`, and the gap between icon and label.

tokens.name: cell-2
tokens.usage: `step_indent = "  "`: two columns before each step icon.

tokens.name: cell-3
tokens.usage: `MIN_SEP_GLYPHS`: the shortest dot run between label and duration.

tokens.name: cell-4
tokens.usage: Error block gutter: icon column (1) + 3, since compact's `rail` is empty.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: One terminal row at the reference cell (about 1.2 × 14px, a typical terminal line height, so │ and ║ join across rows). Blank lines (around the plan header, before a report summary) are one row.

tokens.name: frame-pad
tokens.usage: Padding inside a specimen window in docs.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything ops draws. The terminal grid has no corners; compact rounds only with glyphs (╭─ ╰─).
